children: Overview
US athletic apparel retailer's fiscal Q2 revenue fell 4%, missing analyst expectations
Comparable sales declined 9% in the quarter
Incoming CEO Heidi O'Neill will join the company next week
Shares of the company were down about 14% in extended trading
Outlook
Lululemon expects Q3 revenue of $2.290 bln to $2.320 bln, down 10% to 11%
Company sees Q3 diluted EPS of $0.93 to $0.98
Lululemon now expects 2026 revenue of $10.350 bln to $10.500 bln, down 5% to 7%
Company expects 2026 diluted EPS of $9.48 to $9.73, including $0.86 from tariff refunds
Result Drivers
AMERICAS WEAKNESS - Co reported an 8% decline in Americas net revenue and a 12% drop in Americas comparable sales
TARIFF REFUNDS - $134.5 mln in tariff refunds increased gross margin and contributed $0.86 per share to diluted EPS
INTERNATIONAL GROWTH - Co said international net revenue increased 4%, partially offsetting declines in the Americas
